description: Source code for an IPSO voltage sensor implementation in Zephyr RTOS, defining object resources, creation, and update functions for LWM2M protocol.

methods.name: update_min_measured
methods.description: Updates the minimum measured value and notifies observers.

methods.name: update_max_measured
methods.description: Updates the maximum measured value and notifies observers.

methods.name: reset_min_max_measured_values_cb
methods.description: Callback to reset min/max measured values for a sensor instance.

methods.name: sensor_value_write_cb
methods.description: Callback for writing sensor value, updates min/max accordingly.

methods.name: voltage_sensor_create
methods.description: Creates a new IPSO voltage sensor instance with default values and resources.

methods.name: ipso_voltage_sensor_init
methods.description: Initializes and registers the IPSO voltage sensor object.
